title: Chapter 154
content:
Chapter 154

Yan Country, a small county town in Yuyang County.

At this moment, the county town was already on fire, and countless ordinary people were driven out, their faces were terrified, and tears could not stop falling from their eyes.

These ordinary people have lived in this county for generations, but at this moment, the enemies of the Yan Kingdom drove them out and set fire to their homes, completely cutting off their retreat.

"Hurry up, you untouchables, line up for me, and follow me, otherwise, they will all be killed without mercy!" A mighty knight in armor, holding a whip in the air, waved it in the air, and it hit a On the old man, beat him to roll on the ground.

"You..." Countless people from the country of Yan next to the old man all stared blankly, gritted their teeth and held hands, but they still didn't dare to step forward and resisted.

"Huh! What are you, be honest, be obedient, and you can avoid physical pain. Anyone who resists will die!" With a disdainful snort, these old, weak, women and children are within reach, and the strong men in the family are all dragged into the army , Resisting our imperial country, even with these cripples, he dared to resist our army. As he spoke, the knight drew his sword and pointed it at these ordinary people.

Under the threat of the long sword, these unarmed common people had no choice but to succumb to the knight's majesty, obediently obeyed the orders of these soldiers, and headed far away, leaving their hometown.

The same scene happened not only in this small county, but also in counties and villages all over the country of Yan. Batch after batch of ordinary people were driven to the east of Liaodong.

Yandu, Jicheng, Yanwang Palace.

"What? How dare a thief do this? This is trying to destroy my foundation!" Sitting on his throne, Yan Wangxi listened to his scouts report the information he had heard, and clapped his hands vigorously. He patted the throne and stood up.

"Your Majesty, please calm down and take care of your health. Let those people rob you and rob them! As long as you are the king of the Yan Kingdom, and you are the master of the three counties in the west, then you, as the king Dignity cannot be shaken!" Yanchun Jun persuaded him, he didn't care how many people of Yan State were taken captive by others, he only cared about his own position, whether he was Yan Chun Lord of Yan State.

"Yes, Your Majesty, these people are just batch after batch of grass, and there will be more after mowing. The real territory is real, and your throne is real! Everything else is not important." Yan Yi also spoke out to persuade.

"Damn it, you two treacherous bastards, it's not the fault of you two that my country of Yan has come to this point. Now you dare to make such a policy of harming the country and the people. Father, I ask you to kill these two liars to sue me. I am a citizen of Yan Kingdom!" Prince Dan of Yan Kingdom said angrily when he saw these two traitors were still yelling, and drew out the long sword in his hand.

"You, you spitting blood, all of my plans are old-fashioned strategies for the country, for the sake of the country of Yan, for the sake of the king, you, but a mere child, how can you understand the affairs of the country!" Yan Chunjun panicked for a while, for fear that his nephew would agree to the request.

"That's right, Your Majesty, Prince Dan dared to draw his sword on the court. Please punish him for such a rebellious act!" Hearing that Prince Dan had affected him, Yan Yi quickly seized his negligence and sent a message to Yan Yi. Wang Xi made a small report.

"Okay, let's be presumptuous, above the court, in the solemn place, you are making a scene, even drawing your swords to fight, what's wrong with you, why don't you put away your swords and step back!" , at this time, still doing the same. Yan Wangxi shouted angrily, and ordered Yan Dan to put away his sword.

"Yes, father, the child is impulsive, but some people think that it is better to take the initiative to lead the army to repel the enemy troops outside the city, or even go out of the city to harass them and save more people of Yan Kingdom! "Yan Dan realized that his behavior was a bit excessive, so he quickly put away his sword and changed his strategy.

"Well, what you said is not unreasonable. Although there are many untouchables, if they lose hundreds of thousands at once, the strength of our country of Yan will also be greatly damaged!" Yan Wangxi hesitated when he heard Yan Dan's request.

"Your Majesty, this is a policy that is harmful to the country. The army in my city is no more than half of the enemy army outside the city. Going out of the city is just asking for death. If we lose, I am afraid that the king's city may be overthrown." To agree with Yan Dan's strategy, he said hurriedly in panic.

"That's right, the soldiers in the city are panicking at this moment. If they rush out to fight, I'm afraid they will lose their morale, and they will collapse if they don't fight!" Yan Yi doesn't want to send out the army under him. These are the guarantees of his authority and whether the Yan Kingdom can hold them. The hole card, the danger of going out is too great, he dare not take the risk.

"The two love ministers also said something, but it is a guarantee for the country of Yan, and the loss cannot be too great!" Hearing the reply of the two men, King Yan hesitated again.

"Father..." Hearing that his father was about to reject his suggestion, Yan Dan looked anxiously at Yan Wangxi.

"What Wang'er said is not wrong. Let's put it this way, it is impossible for the whole army to go to war, but I will give you 30,000 troops, led by you, Wang'er, to go out of the city to harass those enemy troops and save the people of my country of Yan!" After thinking and thinking, Yan Wangxi came up with such a compromise plan.

Being able to attack the enemy's plans outside the city and defending the capital with the army left behind, the best of both worlds, taking care of all aspects, King Xi of Yan could not help but feel proud of his wisdom.

"Yes, father, my son will lead the army now, and we will repel the enemy army and rescue the captive people of my country of Yan!" Seeing that his father has made up his mind, it is useless to persuade him any more. Yan Dan sighed inwardly, but still accepted the order.

Walking out of the palace hall in a lonely body, Yanchun and Jun Yan looked at Yan Dan with a sneer behind them, this loser still wants to fight with us? ridiculous?

Yan Dan walked out of the palace gate, looked back at this majestic and magnificent palace, and couldn't help but feel extremely tired in his heart. Could it be that his Yan country, his own country, is really hopeless?

Thinking of his father's hesitation in his heart, Yanchun Lord and his wife's actions that harmed the country and the people, he sighed, but was speechless in the end.

But, no matter what, I still have to do my best to protect him and save him for my country of Yan and my family, even if it delays its fate, even for a moment.

The flames rising from his eyes stepped on the horses of the surrounding guards and ran towards the camp in the city. He had to choose a group of warriors there and go with him to repel the enemy army and protect his homeland. , Once again, Huang Yanguo was in peace.

Presumably, the soldiers in the city held their breath at this moment, after all, the enemies outside the city were robbing their relatives.
